reviews.text: After a big storm hit Balch Springs, my entire roof was damaged and I had serious water leaks. It was late in the day and I needed urgent help to keep my home safe. Hayes Family Roofing & Construction responded quickly—Zachary came out right away to tarp my roof and stop any more water from getting inside. By the next day, I had a clear estimate for the repairs. They recommended a TPO roof, which is strong and perfect for the hot Texas weather. The crew finished the installation in just one day, and the new roof looks fantastic and feels really sturdy. Dale was there to supervise the job. He made sure everything was done right and answered all my questions. He checked on every part of the work, even going up and down the ladder several times to make sure I felt comfortable with everything. The whole team did a great job, and I’m very happy with how my roof turned out.
reviews.author: Patricia Marks

reviews.text: zachary and his crew did a great job from beginning to end replacing my roof here in balch springs. there were lots of choices for shingle colors, and they offered helpful advice to pick the right one for my home. the gutter installation was done really well too, and after a few heavy texas storms, it's nice to have gutters that work the way they should. they kept me updated about the schedule, let me know when things would start and finish, and always answered my questions. i'm very happy with how everything turned out and would definitely recommend hayes family roofing & construction for roofing needs.
reviews.author: Reginald Case

reviews.text: After a big hailstorm here in Balch Springs, our roof started having problems and leaks in several spots. We had a few roofing companies come out, but none of them really helped us get our insurance to cover the damage. The leaks kept getting worse every time it rained, and we were really starting to worry. A neighbor recommended this roofing company to us because they had done a great job on her house after the same storm. When we called, Roger came out and took a good look at our roof. He explained that our type of shingles wasn’t even made anymore, so a full roof replacement was needed. Roger said he’d talk to the insurance company for us and try to get it covered. He kept us in the loop the whole time and worked hard with the insurance people. After a few months of back and forth, he managed to get our insurance to pay for the new roof and even new gutters since those were damaged too! Even though the wait had caused extra damage to some of the roofing materials underneath, everything got fixed up perfectly. Roger and Camden really knew what they were doing and made the whole process a lot less stressful for us. We are really happy with our new roof and would definitely recommend this company to anyone in Balch Springs needing roofing work, especially after storm damage!
reviews.author: Preston A

reviews.text: We recently had a new metal roof, gutters, and downspouts installed on our home in Balch Springs. We found out about Hayes Family Roofing & Construction through a family member who had used their services before. From our first meeting with Camden all the way to the job’s completion, making sure we were happy was always the main focus. Everyone on the crew treated our property with respect and care. Throughout the whole installation, they checked in to make sure we were pleased with how everything was looking, especially the roof and gutters. The pricing and warranty were very reasonable, and the materials they used were top quality. They really stand behind their work, which gave us peace of mind. The cleanup after the job was very thorough—if it weren’t for our new, great-looking roof and gutters, you’d hardly know any work had been done. Whenever we had a question or needed to talk to someone, they got back to us quickly, usually within the hour. We would definitely recommend them to anyone in need of a new roof or siding in the Balch Springs area. They also did a siding repair for us, which turned out even better than the original work. The team’s professionalism and attention to detail made the whole process smooth and stress-free.
reviews.author: Shelly R

reviews.text: After a strong storm hit Balch Springs, we noticed possible roof damage. Our neighbor had just gotten their roof and siding replaced and spoke highly of the team’s work and the quality of materials used. Based on their recommendation, we called and spoke with Roger, who came out the same day to inspect our roof. Roger carefully explained all our options and helped us decide to replace our roof, siding, and gutters. He was a pleasure to work with—his experience, patience, and advice made the process much easier, especially when it came to navigating insurance and picking the right roofing materials for the hot Texas weather. Throughout the project, Roger kept us updated and made sure we understood every step. The roofing crew did an excellent job and made sure everything was cleaned up perfectly when they were finished. We’re extremely happy with how everything turned out and would definitely recommend this company to anyone in Balch Springs looking for dependable roofing or siding work.
reviews.author: beth ochoa

reviews.text: I got a notice on my door about a free roof inspection, so I decided to check it out. Dale from Hayes Family Roofing & Construction came by to take a look at my roof in Balch Springs. He explained everything about the condition of my roof and talked to me about the new types of shingles available, without trying to pressure me into anything. Dale gave me some clear pricing, and after thinking about it, I decided it was a good time to get a new roof. The crew showed up about a week later and worked quickly to replace my roof. They did a great job, and I was impressed by how well they cleaned up afterward—no mess left behind at all. A while back, they also replaced my old deck with a new composite one, and I’ve been really happy with the quality and look of it, especially with the hot Texas weather. I definitely recommend them to any homeowner looking for reliable roofing or deck work.
reviews.author: lisa hess

reviews.text: Hayes Family Roofing & Construction did an outstanding job replacing my roof and updating the siding on my home. Dale, the project manager, was always attentive and knowledgeable, answering every question and quickly handling anything that came up during the process. My house has a unique design and is a bit older, so there were plenty of challenges, but the crew stayed positive and determined every step of the way. For example, my roof has extra-large overhangs, and the soffit is angled up to match the roofline instead of running flat like most homes. Standard soffit materials just wouldn't fit. After looking at different options, they decided to hand-craft each soffit section right there on site, using custom vents made to order. The end result looks amazing—the craftsmanship really stands out. If you take a close look at the siding and the bay window details, you can see how skilled their team is. Overall, I'm thrilled with the work. The whole experience was smooth, and the final results are fantastic. Highly recommend for anyone needing roofing or siding work done, especially if your home has some tricky details or needs custom solutions.
reviews.author: J Schneider

reviews.text: The roofing crew did a fantastic job putting on my new roof, and they got it all finished in just one day. They showed up early in the morning and had the old shingles removed before lunchtime. Every worker, including Camden and Roger, knew exactly what to do—watching them was like seeing a team that’s been working together for years. They used top-quality roofing materials and paid close attention to every detail. I feel confident that my new roof will hold up for many years. I went with charcoal black shingles and a black metal drip edge, which looks really sharp and gives my house a big curb appeal boost. This team truly cares about their work and customer satisfaction. I highly recommend them to anyone needing roofing work done.
reviews.author: Devin M

reviews.text: A few summers back, we had our leaking deck-style roof replaced by Hayes Family Roofing & Construction. The project was complicated and involved replacing a large section of our actual wood deck ceiling, not just swapping out old shingles. For us, fixing the deck itself was the most important part, with the new shingles being a bonus. The crew, led by Zachary, did an outstanding job. Since the work was completed, we haven’t had any more leaks or issues with our roof, which is a huge relief after years of dealing with water damage every time it rained. This is the first time since moving in that the inside of our home has finally started to recover from all the old leaks. Even though some time has passed since the job was finished, I wanted to share this review now because the quality really shows over time. I can confidently say our roof was installed with real skill and attention to detail. The team working on our house was small, and Zachary explained that keeping the crew smaller helped them closely watch over every part of the job to make sure it was done right. We really appreciated that level of care. Zachary was also very easy to talk to—he listened closely to what we needed and approached our concerns like a true professional. He stood out from all the other roofers we had met before, taking the time to understand exactly what our family needed instead of just trying to make a quick sale. If you want your roof repaired or replaced with real expertise and honesty, I highly recommend this company. They’re a well-established family business you can trust, not just a fly-by-night outfit looking to make a quick buck.
reviews.author: Isla Rojas

reviews.text: roger and his crew showed up right on schedule and completed our new roof in just two days. roger made sure to cover the area around our house with large tarps to protect everything, and the team did a very thorough clean-up when they finished. if you need a roof replaced in balch springs, you can count on getting professional service, quality shingles at a fair price, and a solid warranty. the whole process was smooth and stress-free. honestly, the hardest part was picking out the roof color, but it turned out looking fantastic!
reviews.author: Malik Buchanan

reviews.text: We had new gutters, gutter covers, and downspouts put on my mom's house in Balch Springs, and they did a really good job. camden and dale were super helpful when setting up the estimate and scheduling the work. my mom said the crew showed up right on time, worked hard, and kept everything tidy—her yard was left spotless. the new gutters made the house look even better, and the covers have stopped all the neighbor's leaves and debris from blocking things up. now, water flows perfectly when it rains. we’re very pleased with the quality of the work and would definitely tell friends, family, and neighbors to use this roofer.
reviews.author: Peyton12 F

reviews.text: Like many homeowners, I only realized I had a roof leak when heavy rain hit. I came across Hayes Family Roofing & Construction online, where they had lots of great reviews. Scheduling was straightforward and Camden was always on time, which made the process stress-free. The inspection was detailed, and the repairs were handled efficiently without anyone trying to push extra work I didn’t need. If anyone I know ever needs roofing help, I’d definitely recommend them for quality roof repairs.
reviews.author: Alicia Bradley

reviews.text: After getting three different quotes, i decided to go with Hayes Family Roofing & Construction to replace my old tar and gravel roof with a standing seam metal roof. their price was the best out of the three. zachary was always on time, very responsive, and made sure the crew did the job right. my roof needed a lot of carpentry because of how bad the old wood was—several support beams, fascia, and decking had to be replaced. they also installed new rain gutters and built an extra screened-in porch, and both were finished with the same great quality as the roof. i really trust their work and would definitely call them again for any repairs or new projects.
reviews.author: Connor Lozano

reviews.text: A few years ago, I had a roof leak and my insurance company recommended Hayes Family Roofing & Construction. The team fixed my roof, and it turned out great! I love how my dark green roof stands out in the neighborhood whenever I come home. Recently, I noticed some damaged shingles and called for help. Roger answered my call right away, and the repair was done the very next day. I didn’t have to stress about finding someone else or dealing with water damage from rain. The team remembered me, which made the experience even better. Their work ethic and quick response are truly impressive. I’m very thankful for such reliable service.
reviews.author: Bianca7 O

reviews.text: Camden did an outstanding job making my roof repairs easy and stress-free. I would gladly recommend him for any roofing needs. He was very knowledgeable, especially when it came to working on older homes like mine. After having trouble with a few other contractors, working with Camden really restored my confidence in local roofing professionals. If you need a dependable roofer, definitely give Hayes Family Roofing & Construction a call—you won't be disappointed! I'm really happy I chose them for my project.
reviews.author: Leroy Conley

reviews.text: After a strong, windy storm in Balch Springs, we noticed a leak in our roof. We reached out to Hayes Family Roofing & Construction and were pleasantly surprised when Roger was able to schedule us for a free roof inspection the very next day. Camden showed up right on time, took a close look at our leak, and then completed a thorough inspection of the entire roof at no charge. Camden was friendly, professional, and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. He pointed out the likely cause of the leak and gave us great advice on how to handle the minor repair ourselves. Thanks to his clear guidance, we were able to fix the issue quickly and easily. Camden also pointed out a couple of areas to monitor in the future, just to be safe. The service was outstanding—Camden took his time, answered all our questions, and shared his expert knowledge. We really appreciated the free inspection and the honest advice. We’ll definitely call them again for any roofing needs and highly recommend their services to anyone in Balch Springs. Five stars all the way!
reviews.author: Rodney Wright

reviews.text: After a family member recommended Hayes Family Roofing & Construction, I decided to reach out for help with my flat roof in Balch Springs. As a newer homeowner, I wasn't sure how roof repairs or cool roof coatings worked, especially when it comes to leaks. Roger from the crew did an amazing job and really knew his way around roof repairs. He quickly found the problem areas and explained everything in simple terms, which helped ease my worries about leaks. Camden made sure setting up the whole project was simple and stress-free. The team worked efficiently, stayed professional, and left my home looking great. I’m happy to recommend this company to my friends and family—thanks to them, I’m finally enjoying peace of mind knowing my roof is in good shape and ready for the Texas heat.
reviews.author: Marilyn M

reviews.text: Overall, I had an excellent experience. A neighbor recommended a local roofing company in Balch Springs. Roger was very knowledgeable and answered all the questions I had about the roofing process. I was impressed when he met my insurance adjuster and me early in the morning to discuss everything. He scheduled my roof replacement quickly, just a few days later. The crew was friendly and easy to work with, and they made sure to clean up all the debris when they finished. I chose to upgrade my shingles, and I really appreciated Roger helping me with the paperwork for my insurance company so I could save on my home insurance. Great job!
reviews.author: Dale Watson
